description: Second held-out QA set for Memory.ask, written by Claude on 2026-10-02 before the next change to the relevance check was designed: 20 facts about a fictional clinic and one of its patients, 25 questions the facts answer (paraphrases, small inferences, English questions about Italian facts and the reverse) and 25 near misses on the same people and places.

facts.text: Dr. Lena Marchi is the cardiologist at the Aurora clinic.
The Aurora clinic opens at 7:30 on weekdays.
Giorgio takes 5 mg of bisoprolol every morning.
Giorgio's next check-up is on 14 November.
The clinic's lab results are sent by email within 48 hours.
Giorgio is allergic to amoxicillin.
Parking at the clinic costs 2 euros per hour.
Giorgio's wife Carla works as a nurse.
The clinic moved its X-ray room to the second floor.
Giorgio stopped smoking in 2019.
Il centralino della clinica risponde dalle 8 alle 18.
Giorgio corre 10 km ogni domenica.
La dottoressa Marchi riceve il martedì e il giovedì.
Il figlio di Giorgio si chiama Matteo e studia ingegneria a Torino.
La clinica accetta pagamenti con carta e bonifico.
Giorgio ha prenotato una risonanza magnetica al ginocchio sinistro.
Il ticket per la visita cardiologica costa 36 euro.
Giorgio segue una dieta povera di sale.
La clinica è chiusa il 25 dicembre e il 1° gennaio.
Giorgio preferisce essere chiamato al numero fisso.
